name: Clock Hub
author: Niklas Braun (nibra180)
description: Theme-aware clock hub with calendar, MPRIS media controls, and Omarchy Agents usage.

barWidget.description: Clock, calendar, media, and agent usage in one expandable hub

schema.label: Media
schema.description: Show media artwork, playback controls, and the bar's now-playing indicator.

schema.label: Agents
schema.description: Show agent usage, limits, and model totals in the hub.

schema.label: System status
schema.description: Show CPU, memory, disk usage, and the btop shortcut.

schema.label: Google Calendar
schema.description: Show read-only Google Calendar events in the hub.

schema.label: Now-playing indicator
schema.description: Choose the animated media indicator shown beside the clock while audio is playing.
